comparison.meaning: The four previously reported vulnerabilities are not detected in the newly built image, and corresponding packages are upgraded. This is not proof that all possible security vulnerabilities are absent.

dependency_verification.inventory_count_note: Gradle module coordinates and scanner package discovery are different inventories. dependency_verification.build_test_codegen_classpaths: Their inventory is available, but image runtime vulnerability scanning does not certify separate build/test/code-generation classpath security.

source_identity.note: Only API README differs from the image source snapshot; runtime source/build/generated/test inputs remain matched.
